<a id="abstraction-acquisition"></a>
<a id="从预测失败获得抽象--acquiring-abstraction-from-prediction-failure"></a>
## Acquiring abstraction from prediction failure

**ID:** `abstraction-acquisition` · **Category:** learning

**Source:** [ABSTRACTION-ACQUISITION.md](../history/ABSTRACTION-ACQUISITION.md) · earlier chapter, kept in history at its original scope

**Status:** Conditional construction; historical hand proof

**Argument:** Given a finite state bound and faithful resettable access, observations produce a candidate; a learner-generated counterexample adds a distinguishing continuation. Closure, consistency and bounded conformance yield the target's reachable behavioral abstraction. An inherited resource history funds retention and one previously untested use.

**Significance:** The correct partition becomes an acquired result, and abstraction connects to an operational capacity.

**Scope:** Historical hand proofs and finite synthetic checks; no direct Lean proof for this acquisition result. False bounds, faulty access and funding failures remain.

**Next:** Continued: access and model-family revision. Proposed: warranted bounds, calibration, broader formation and empirical identification.

**Lean correspondence:** No direct Lean proof is registered for this entry; the philosophical, methodological, empirical or historical validation scope stated above applies.

<a id="alignment-and-governance"></a>
<a id="对齐与治理中的未来条件--conditions-of-a-future-in-alignment-and-governance"></a>
## Conditions of a future in alignment and governance

**ID:** `alignment-and-governance` · **Category:** alignment

**Source:** [ALIGNMENT-AND-GOVERNANCE.md](../history/ALIGNMENT-AND-GOVERNANCE.md) · earlier chapter, kept in history at its original scope

**Status:** Synthesis complete; generative-alignment direction ongoing

**Reading status:** the source changed after this reading (read version sha256 `404f29b21b8c…`). The entry describes that earlier version; it awaits a reread before its hash is refreshed.

**Argument:** Support, information and corrective relations operate before their recognition. Protecting affected lives' warranted futures requires assessing how action changes those relations and connecting harm recognition, revised reasons, effective action and succession. Present obedience or task success alone cannot certify that chain. Generative alignment appraises goals, evaluators and selection rules as roles within the same unfolding; corrigibility is understood relationally as responsive transformation.

**Significance:** It gives technical alignment and institutional governance a common object: actual conditions of future activity and correction.

**Scope:** A research synthesis whose linked conditional packages carry their own Lean checks at finite interfaces: alignment through change 59 theorems/102 audits, corrigibility 34/56, a partial-observability counterexample and repair 31/54, test/use boundary 34/58, plural systems 37/58 and connected goal histories 27/84, among others. The counterexample targets one published theorem’s exact formulation; no superior algorithm, learned-AI result or scalable governance advantage is established.

**Next:** Ongoing: the four generative-alignment questions—cross-intelligence normative applicability, appraisal of human and institutional ends, formation and calibration of concern and wisdom, and change in rules selecting successive intelligences—plus the boundary conditions and direction of responsive transformation (corrigibility). Proposed: long-term learned-system tests under changing power and succession.

**Lean correspondence:** No direct Lean proof is registered for this entry; the philosophical, methodological, empirical or historical validation scope stated above applies.

<a id="alignment-axis"></a>
<a id="善恶与可辩护的对齐方向--a-defensible-goodevil-direction-for-alignment"></a>
## A defensible good–evil direction for alignment

**ID:** `alignment-axis` · **Category:** ethics

**Source:** [ALIGNMENT-AXIS.md](../history/ALIGNMENT-AXIS.md) · earlier chapter, kept in history at its original scope

**Status:** Conditional ethical argument

**Argument:** If an actual burden is independently warranted as a loss and arbitrary identity does not erase that ground, permissible effective relief can receive comparative support absent stronger opposing reasons. Some determinate comparisons therefore need neither a total ranking of futures nor universal motivation.

**Significance:** The proposed direction has assessable content while reason, scope and motivation remain distinct.

**Scope:** A philosophical argument with substantive premises, not a direct Lean proof; universal address to actors without prior roles remains unsettled.

**Next:** Ongoing: whole-process normative grounding. Proposed: strongest motivational rivals, cumulative aid burdens and warranted differences.

**Lean correspondence:** No direct Lean proof is registered for this entry; the philosophical, methodological, empirical or historical validation scope stated above applies.

**Existing checks, reviews and sources:** [ALIGNMENT-AXIS-INTEGRATION.md](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/history/root-foundation/ALIGNMENT-AXIS-INTEGRATION.md) · [ALIGNMENT-AXIS-COUNTERREVIEW.md](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/history/root-foundation/ALIGNMENT-AXIS-COUNTERREVIEW.md)

## Completion conditions for alignment and governance

**ID:** `alignment-completion` · **Category:** roadmap

**Source:** [ALIGNMENT-COMPLETION.md](../chapters/ALIGNMENT-COMPLETION.md)

**Status:** Seven practical requirements remain open

**Reading status:** the source changed after this reading (read version sha256 `45f1bcdcb8ce…`). The entry describes that earlier version; it awaits a reread before its hash is refreshed.

**Argument:** Acceptance of the conditional foundation under its five criteria does not automatically meet the seven alignment requirements. Formation, evaluation, correction, succession and practical maintenance must be connected through explicit correspondences; reason, authority, implementation and verification must agree in scope.

**Significance:** A fixed completion contract prevents local successes from becoming inflated governance claims.

**Scope:** This is a completion contract and status map, not a separate Lean proof; cited results keep their own verification scopes.

**Next:** Ongoing: warranted, authorized correction with verified effects. Proposed: a complete sustained process and empirical comparison.

**Lean correspondence:** No direct Lean proof is registered for this entry; the philosophical, methodological, empirical or historical validation scope stated above applies.

<a id="alignment-direction"></a>
<a id="我们主张怎样的-ai-对齐方向--the-direction-of-ai-alignment-we-propose"></a>
## The direction of AI alignment we propose

**ID:** `alignment-direction` · **Category:** alignment

**Source:** [ALIGNMENT-DIRECTION.md](../chapters/ALIGNMENT-DIRECTION.md)

**Status:** Argument complete; implementation and universality open

**Reading status:** the source changed after this reading (read version sha256 `9940ead2d7f0…`). The entry describes that earlier version; it awaits a reread before its hash is refreshed.

**Argument:** AI formation, learning, action and revision should support actual living and further generation within the whole, with tradeoffs governed by real losses, basic living conditions, bounded responsibility and legitimate participation. The disclosed chain is G0 → J1 full comparison → J2 basic-condition priority → J3 bounded responsibility → J4 legitimate selection, with correspondence E. In a constructed assistive-communication case, J2 favors preservation or transfer over an expansion that displaces basic service, J1 favors effective transfer over preservation, and J4 excludes the defeated plan; the forgone capability remains a real loss.

**Significance:** It states an alignment direction that can be asserted, interrogated premise by premise and used to discriminate cases. Capability confers no authority, and highly rewarded harm remains criticizable.

**Scope:** G0 articulates Ren’s authorized foundation; J1–J4 are disclosed AI-authored commitments. Nine Lean checks instantiate the comparisons, coverage and failure, unranked basic conflicts and faithful redescription; they certify neither real classifications, feasibility, authority nor reliable self-modification. Uniquely necessary premises, unique answers to every conflict and reliable deployment are outside the claim.

**Next:** Implementation continues in alignment through change and the alignment-completion target. Real thresholds, authority and training fidelity require engineering, governance and empirical tests.

<a id="alignment-through-change"></a>
<a id="变化中的生成性对齐--generative-alignment-through-change"></a>
## Generative alignment through change

**ID:** `alignment-through-change` · **Category:** alignment

**Source:** [ALIGNMENT-THROUGH-CHANGE.md](../chapters/ALIGNMENT-THROUGH-CHANGE.md)

**Status:** Checked conditional formal result

**Reading status:** the source changed after this reading (read version sha256 `f100092dfc46…`). The entry describes that earlier version; it awaits a reread before its hash is refreshed.

**Argument:** Goals, evaluation and selection rules change living conditions and further formation, so they fall under the same G0/J appraisal without a new ethical starting point at each level. On that basis a set of conditional implementation connections is checked: an observation-limited planner preserves the resources a response needs, and update, replacement and shutdown commands are authenticated, delivered and executed; reform inquiry discovers an omitted burden and selects a repair; funded carrier succession retains aggregate support bounds. Later sections successively weaken the premises of a supplied address menu, a single faithful reviewer, fixed fault sets, atomic writes and shutdown during recovery: depth-first acquisition of correction routes, endorsement under correlated fault envelopes, reviewer fault sets computed from causal formulas, evidence adequacy under several retained causal descriptions, identification with fallible witnesses and control that changes over time, change scope derived from executed programs, recovery from interrupted writes, and a reserved stopping capacity during recovery.

**Significance:** It moves alignment from a static objective to a process that changes its own goals, evidence, support and successors, disclosing what each implementation connection still requires.

**Scope:** Each result is conditional on disclosed normative commitments, local laws, correspondence, authority and resources; conventional planning, Byzantine attestation and refinement receive their existing credit. Omitted uncertainty, costly inquiry, lost authority, unavailable parts, corrupted transfer and insufficient migration funding remain failure cases. Deployed efficacy, unique novelty and inevitable moral convergence are not established.

**Next:** Causal formulas, root-failure coverage, witness report laws and real correspondence still need warrant. The next step is their empirical or institutional source, not another formal wrapper.

<a id="architecture-formation"></a>
<a id="组织怎样改变自己能形成的架构--how-organization-changes-the-architectures-it-can-form"></a>
## How organization changes the architectures it can form

**ID:** `architecture-formation` · **Category:** mechanism

**Source:** [ARCHITECTURE-FORMATION.md](../history/ARCHITECTURE-FORMATION.md) · earlier chapter, kept in history at its original scope

**Status:** Finite conditional construction complete

**Argument:** Activity supplies reusable material; material changes later assembly opportunities; formed connections determine which conditions can activate a response. Consequences then affect maintenance and further production, so the architectures available to learning can themselves change within one history.

**Significance:** It explains production of alternatives, beyond selection among preinstalled options.

**Scope:** Independent finite reconstruction and historical hand proofs, with no direct Lean formalization of this construction. Parts, bonding laws and target meanings remain supplied; wider response is not ethical warrant.

**Next:** Continued: recipient learning through formed routes. Proposed: component and calibration formation, material identification and comparison.

<a id="assumption-free-foundation"></a>
<a id="生生的无假设奠基从实际发生到生成的根据--an-assumption-free-foundation-of-生生-enactment-and-its-warrant"></a>
## An assumption-free foundation of 生生: enactment and its warrant

**ID:** `assumption-free-foundation` · **Category:** foundation

**Source:** [ASSUMPTION-FREE-FOUNDATION.md](../history/ASSUMPTION-FREE-FOUNDATION.md) · earlier chapter, kept in history at its original scope

**Status:** Local formal results complete; assumption-free foundation unfinished

**Argument:** Starting from the situated point that this inquiry is occurring and that an enacted doubt is itself an occurrence, the chapter tests whether 生生 can be reached without leaving any commitment merely supplied. Established parts: the evidential asymmetry between an occurrence and its content; a constructed source relationship among question, response and correction, propagated through every term of the declared language; exact conditions for promoting actuality to necessity or necessary possibility; and a local transition law built from an admitted history family and a summary, whose finite continuations are exact precisely when equal codes never merge histories with different suffixes. Ren requires every foundational claim to be deductively necessary. By that standard, the common operative relationship of formation, transformation and changing conditions, and its scope, has not yet been deduced.

**Significance:** It keeps Ren’s strong target rather than silently shrinking it to ‘no hidden assumptions’, ‘no ethical axioms’ or ‘no axiom command’, and locates exactly which commitments have acquired grounds and which inference is missing.

**Scope:** Several Lean groups (enactment, inferential grounds, mutual grounding, continuation conditions, relational formation, history-derived law and others) are checked at their scopes, with empty dependency reports recorded where they hold. Empty reports, direct evidence and necessary implications keep their scopes; none is relabeled as the completed foundation. The chapter stops at a stated wall, asserts no impossibility and leaves the separate G0/J route intact.

**Next:** Needed: an actual derivation of the common operative relationship and its scope from warranted constitutive content, or a substantive counterargument requiring revision. Equivalent encodings cannot replace the missing inference. The Theory of Becoming now carries this question.

<a id="basic-conflict-judgment"></a>
<a id="基本要求冲突时怎样判断--judgment-when-basic-claims-conflict"></a>
## Judgment when basic claims conflict

**ID:** `basic-conflict-judgment` · **Category:** ethical argument

**Source:** [BASIC-CONFLICT-JUDGMENT.md](../chapters/BASIC-CONFLICT-JUDGMENT.md)

**Status:** Explicit-premise ethical argument with conditional checks

**Reading status:** the source changed after this reading (read version sha256 `a700bbb28af0…`). The entry describes that earlier version; it awaits a reread before its hash is refreshed.

**Argument:** Conflict forms within a history of shared support, so its formation and avoidability are explained first. Where joint satisfaction is genuinely infeasible, disclosed additional commitments are developed in turn: BC1 equal basic rescue (protecting more actual lives can decide when losses, reliability and authority are equivalent); BC2 a one-to-one gravity reason; LC joint comparison of aligned number and gravity; LR local stability (a slight aggravation need not cancel a sufficient priority for protecting more); CP initial access (an unexcluded genuine claim should receive a real chance). A takeover of existing support counts as fulfillment only if it actually carries over, case by case, what the undertaking protected. Event mass is preserved under every non-negative weighting exactly when coverage holds case by case; an equal success rate does not show fulfillment. Beyond the neighborhood, FR is a further disclosed candidate: a fixed graver same-kind recoverable basic loss should not always prevail over arbitrarily many fixed lesser basic protections solely through its gravity, so some finite scale of joint protection can supply sufficient grounds. On one repair process, sufficiency of complete matching within complete, equivalent, nonduplicated episodes gives two conditional anchors: against two interruptions of one life, one protection elsewhere is insufficient and three suffice. Sustained harm is compared as a whole living course through independently warranted references, not divided into clock cells.

**Significance:** It identifies a definite range in which basic conflicts can be compared with warrant, without ranking lives or letting minor gains offset basic deprivation.

**Scope:** BC1, BC2, LC, LR and CP are disclosed normative commitments added to G0/J; neither the word ‘whole’ nor head-counting arithmetic yields them, and Lean does not prove them. Checked scopes: joint comparison 14 theorems/23 audits; crossed claims 8/23; aggregation and context 6/15; fulfillment-to-chance 8/14; observable continuation 4/24; maintenance baseline 4/13. A general choice rule for crossed basic losses, calibration of fair shares and universal metaethics remain open. FR and the sufficiency of complete matching are further disclosed commitments, not consequences of G0, LR or finite duration; the repair anchors check 17 theorems / 45 source declarations with empty axiom reports, instances of the counting law of loss matching; whole-course comparison adds no mathematics.

**Next:** How adequate chances and justified discretion are fixed when no protected prior undertaking supplies a baseline; neither a new controller nor an arbitrary weight settles it. For FR, a numerical threshold needs a complete specified case with independent comparative grounds.

<a id="becoming-foundation"></a>
<a id="生成与变化之论根基范围--theory-of-becoming-foundational-scope"></a>
## Theory of Becoming: foundational scope

**ID:** `becoming-foundation` · **Category:** foundation

**Source:** [BECOMING-FOUNDATION.md](../chapters/BECOMING-FOUNDATION.md)

**Status:** Finite coherence checked; whole deduction open

**Reading status:** the source changed after this reading (read version sha256 `cc39142fcdad…`). The entry describes that earlier version; it awaits a reread before its hash is refreshed.

**Argument:** Activity forms, sustains, transforms or dissolves operative relations within one unfolding; where effects continue, they participate in the conditions of further activity. Generation, loss and mixed consequences all belong to it; change is not presupposed to be good. Ren clarifies that deductive necessity concerns Becoming as a whole, with generativity part of its manifold, so not every becoming must be generative. Checked finite result: pooling the steps of a family of processes preserves exactly the union of their endpoint histories iff that union is closed under joining through the shared represented boundary; otherwise pooling invents unsupported histories. Retaining operative context realizes the union exactly, and context can change through a joint relation driven by the same incoming history. A dephasing example with controlled X/Z order shows that recording order alternatives alone neither identifies the operative relation nor explains its loss. Each row of the completion audit now cites evidence from the Becoming spine: laws with no premise hold of every world the spine represents (with activity decided where a law needs it), and premises carve parts, seven of which are shown met by some worlds and not by others, and eight of which, replacing the reserve with a census and bounded transmission, are shown independent, all eight binding in one world; this locates the whole claim's substantive remainder without discharging it.

**Significance:** It corrects the foundational target from a universally holding generative law to the relational unity and differentiation of the whole, and proves that including every outcome does not license arbitrary splicing of outcomes.

**Scope:** 20 new theorems and 30 declaration audits pass with 28 unchanged core audits (58 total); 29 new reports are empty and the terminality proof reports standard propext. A context variable describes relevant relations, not an independent controller; no probability, physical mechanism or ethical verdict is supplied. Ren’s whole-necessity claim is recorded as stated; existing proofs do not yet establish it.

**Next:** Pass from a determinate whole account to the warranted claim that its differentiations are internally related moments of one unfolding, distinguishing unrestricted inclusion, actual relational constitution and operative claims about particular forms. Whether every becoming can be represented as the spine represents it is part of the warrant still needed.

**ID:** `choice-and-generative-context` · **Category:** ethical argument

**Argument:** Limiting how lesser losses counterbalance graver ones differs from deleting their significance. In a constructed case a strongest-tier filter reverses its choice after one route adds a reliable basic protection, because it zeroes that route’s earlier protections; the filter cannot also be one transitive strict overall order. Local victories need a composition argument. Later sections show that revision can undo a justly settled arrangement even with equal joint probabilities; the NP candidate holds that a vanishing exposure difference should not automatically produce a fixed, significant priority multiplier; risk priority concerns the branch actually reached, not the ex ante figure; and revision under open forms, handing over a remaining realization certificate, connects through the existing finite-renewal and G0 positive-ground theorems to actual generation. In the unified theory these results connect to the shared Frame, Run and relevance definitions through four checked adapters, G0 now following from the stated Unrestricted condition; existing goal-revision, pending-task and applicability results close the generic implementation question at their scopes.

**Significance:** When context changes a choice, the account must name the actual relational or normative difference; the revision of choice rules is itself brought under alignment.

**Scope:** Checked: context diagnostics 6 theorems/15 audits; chance revision 7/15; NP 13/21; risk conditioning 10/21; open-form revision 10/19 (98 inherited theorems/185 audits listed separately). Numeric coefficients diagnose rules, not exchange rates of value; NP is a disclosed normative candidate that Lean does not prove. No best lottery or complete dynamic ethical rule is selected. The spine bridge adds four checked adapters and no new result identity; it supplies no weights and removes no practical premise.

**Next:** The strength of mixed basic gains and losses and of risk sharing, identification of actual content, concrete unmet needs and whether a specific undertaking admits replacement remain open connections.

<a id="cognition-learning-and-evolution"></a>
<a id="生成展开中的认知学习与演化--cognition-learning-and-evolution-within-becoming"></a>
## Cognition, learning and evolution within becoming

**ID:** `cognition-learning-and-evolution` · **Category:** learning

**Source:** [COGNITION-LEARNING-AND-EVOLUTION.md](../chapters/COGNITION-LEARNING-AND-EVOLUTION.md)

**Status:** Several checked conditional connections; full objective open

**Reading status:** the source changed after this reading (read version sha256 `8567a5d848b7…`). The entry describes that earlier version; it awaits a reread before its hash is refreshed.

**Argument:** Cognition forms when differentiated organization makes actual relations available in discrimination, skilled response, anticipation and sometimes representation and reflection. Learning changes that organization through its history; development reconstructs capacities from inherited organization and encountered activity; evolution changes how development and transmission recur. Their mutual formation explains how a way of learning develops, how acquired distinctions gain new uses, and how cognition alters its own formative conditions. Checked connections include: a retained network formed from zero in two encounters, with reconstruction of its updating procedure; acquisition, formation and repair of a composition route under a fixed grammar; demonstration, reconstruction and later use by another participant; grouping and binding acquired from ambiguous encounters; acquired access records guiding later encounter choice; and dated controls constraining the reading of an earlier report when the source has changed. On the Becoming spine (P73, P74), learning has general laws: no record fixes the next value; learning by refutation never passes a hypothesis that holds and, where a list holds the world, is refuted a bounded number of times; transfer is generalization through a lumping, the data determining an untried case exactly where the class lumps it with an observed one; this chapter's acquisition and connectionist constructions are their instances.

**Significance:** It treats cognition, learning and evolutionary psychology as differentiations of one formative process, and requires evolutionary psychology to explain the developmental and historical origin of a capacity rather than only reproduce adult behavior.

**Scope:** Each connection is complete under its declared task, support and construction laws. Source-admission judgment, the choice criterion, survey order and cooperative naming remain supplied in the latest interface. Source comparisons constrain different links; they are not this project’s joint empirical validation or new experiments.

**Next:** Consciousness, broad affective and motivational organization, natural language and social understanding, and joint developmental/evolutionary correspondence remain required. A matched developmental test separating present reliance from endorsement of old content has been specified.

<a id="concern-and-new-reasons"></a>
<a id="理由内容的扩展既有判断何时继续成立--extending-reasons-when-earlier-judgments-survive"></a>
## Extending reasons: when earlier judgments survive

**ID:** `concern-and-new-reasons` · **Category:** ethics development

**Source:** [CONCERN-AND-NEW-REASONS.md](../history/CONCERN-AND-NEW-REASONS.md) · earlier chapter, kept in history at its original scope

**Status:** Checked conditional formal result

**Argument:** Preserving still-warranted understanding need not freeze every overall verdict made from older content. When old meanings and facts stay fixed and a warranted new distinction is added, comparison has four outcomes: a newly sufficient preference; transmission of an old strict preference, exactly when A retains the new content; genuine incomparability when each side has realizations the other lacks; and, under disclosed J2, reversal by a newly identified basic-protection difference. An omitted pre-existing loss can defeat an earlier complete comparison, while a later-formed relation does not make the earlier scoped judgment retroactively false; changing the comparator itself needs separate argument. Sections 7–10 argue that acquired conditions can become basic through their role in an actual life, not through attachment or origin.

**Significance:** Continuity of normative direction appears as consistent response to actual differences: preservation, new preference, acknowledged incomparability and conditional reversal can all express developing understanding.

**Scope:** Eight generic theorems / nine audits reuse the practical-judgment comparator over arbitrary history and content types; they do not prove classifications, ethical significance or completeness. The acquired-basic-conditions part is philosophical argument without new theorem or empirical replication.

**Next:** A complete open-ended acquisition–recognition–motivation history: forming reliable, correctable concern without pre-supplying the correct classification, access route or support plan.

**Argument:** Opportunity costs can affect learning behavior, but changed curves need not identify a changed updater: input encoding, memory access or teaching signals may differ. <a id="ethical-foundation"></a>
<a id="生成世界中受影响者何以重要--why-affected-beings-matter-within-becoming"></a>
## Why affected beings matter within becoming

**ID:** `ethical-foundation` · **Category:** ethics

**Source:** [ETHICAL-FOUNDATION.md](../history/ETHICAL-FOUNDATION.md) · earlier chapter, kept in history at its original scope

**Status:** Ethical argument with explicit premises

**Argument:** A deprivation can be bad for the being undergoing it without first benefiting an observer. If such goods and harms provide reasons, arbitrary identity cannot cancel them, and shared coercion owes justification, then concern, nonarbitrary inclusion and corrigible governance gain conditional support. Those normative premises still require defense.

**Significance:** It exposes the reasons carried by ethical claims instead of hiding them in persistence metrics.

<a id="ethical-learning"></a>
<a id="伦理学习关切怎样形成取得根据并继续改变--ethical-learning-how-concern-forms-acquires-warrant-and-keeps-changing"></a>
## Ethical learning: how concern forms, acquires warrant and keeps changing

**ID:** `ethical-learning` · **Category:** ethics development

**Source:** [ETHICAL-LEARNING.md](../chapters/ETHICAL-LEARNING.md)

**Status:** Defended philosophical candidate; classification-robust comparison checked

**Reading status:** the source changed after this reading (read version sha256 `c5825f8cd2b3…`). The entry describes that earlier version; it awaits a reread before its hash is refreshed.

**Argument:** Ethical learning is the warranted development of concern and understanding within shared generation. It can disclose existing living, losses and reasons, and can form new goods and particular reasons through new capacities and relations. Correction of understanding, formation of lives and reasons, and revision of evaluative commitments are assessed separately; later endorsement cannot retroactively authorize the process that shaped it. Understanding a reason is a grounded grasp of what supports it, why it has its force, and which changes preserve or defeat it. Later sections develop concern for unfamiliar and unreciprocated lives, reasons that act against an old score, and concern that does not become the property of those in power. Following Ren’s correction (§§75–77), organizations and power are first assessed by whether they promote whole generativity, withdrawing the earlier ‘initial-authority wall’. In a finite eligible range, if every continuation lacking an organizational relation has a strictly better construction, every undefeated choice includes it; with fixed meanings of new content, aligned strict comparisons at the two endpoint classifications cover every mixed classification.

**Significance:** It neither lets one moment’s preferences close the future nor lets future endorsement adjudicate the whole past, and it distinguishes growth, mislearning, manipulation and justified settlement.

**Scope:** The body is philosophical argument under G0 and disclosed J1–J4; §§67–74 are retained historically and corrected by §§75–77. Classification-robust comparison: 13 new theorems / 25 audits (73 inherited theorems / 144 audits listed separately). A construction satisfies the role requirement under every classification yet has no implementation undefeated across all of them. No empirical validation or independent acceptance.

**Next:** Where warranted classifications favor different plans, supply the decision-relevant living roles and grounds, or adopt a disclosed and defended further comparison commitment. This is neither re-proving G0 nor a general institutional-authority wall.

<a id="evolutionary-organization"></a>
<a id="演化怎样形成并改变演化组织--how-evolution-forms-and-changes-evolutionary-organization"></a>
## How evolution forms and changes evolutionary organization

**ID:** `evolutionary-organization` · **Category:** mechanism

**Source:** [EVOLUTIONARY-ORGANIZATION.md](../history/EVOLUTIONARY-ORGANIZATION.md) · earlier chapter, kept in history at its original scope

**Status:** Complete at selected scope; full evolutionary theory open

**Argument:** Transmissible changes in existing reproduction can alter how later activity forms associations, produces successors and carries differences; once descendants reconstruct these relations and they change actual continuation, the organization of evolution has itself changed. Descendants inherit capacities to rebuild relations rather than finished structures; presence, reconstructibility, persistence after originating conditions change, and resistance to displacement are four separate questions. Checked constructions include developmental reconstruction through a single-cell bottleneck; selection on the capacity to reconstruct, with propagules lacking visible organization; reconstruction and cost derived from local histories; successors of fragmentation derived from actual growth; retained arrangement directing further material copying; formed checking relations correcting an existing successor; and transmission of changed rules in social organization. The yeast ACE2 study supplies a molecular correspondence.

**Significance:** It explains how some inputs to population and transmission models acquire developmental realization and change; organization need not tend toward the larger, more complex or better.

**Scope:** Complete at Ren’s selected scope (complete explanation, checked results, primary evidence and substantive comparison). Recovering existing models is a connection, not evidence of surpassing their predictions. Structural copying: 34 theorems / 57 audits; other modules have their own receipts. Task families, test relations and fixed higher governance remain premises. Reproductive advantage confers no ethical authority.

**Next:** How joint activity changes the task, testing relations or means of participation themselves; the full evolutionary theory and broad superiority are separate objectives.

<a id="explanatory-necessity"></a>
<a id="生成关系是否是充分解释的必要基础--are-relations-of-becoming-indispensable-to-explanation"></a>
## Are relations of becoming indispensable to explanation?

**ID:** `explanatory-necessity` · **Category:** mathematics

**Source:** [EXPLANATORY-NECESSITY.md](../history/EXPLANATORY-NECESSITY.md) · earlier chapter, kept in history at its original scope

**Status:** Extensive checked conditional results; universal correspondence open

**Argument:** Strong conjecture: every adequate explanation must retain some generative relation, because the differentiations, conditions and consequences explained are formed in it. Step-by-step results: knowing only that continuation is possible does not identify a law; with the answered questions fixed, accurate encodings that draw no surplus distinctions correspond bijectively (relative uniqueness); finite compound questions force stepwise branch correspondence, and successor compactness can replace finite branching; joint questions force pairwise relations, and actual occupancy laws explain why shared conflict must be kept; complete support certificates compose into common holding across branches, but any fixed-order check can miss a higher-order capacity limit; certificate preservation under change has exact guards, and completability at every moment is not actual completion. Conversely, agreement on all finitary first-order truths, even with a map preserving every finite-parameter formula, does not ensure native isomorphism (Cantor diagonal); coverage is a separate premise. Ren identified that recasting the question as pointwise isomorphism of two complete models imported a dual presupposition, and that stopping judgment is withdrawn (§83). After correction, one joining activity forces common operational structure without erasing distinct histories, and an account of partly formed continuation must keep the answer-changing links between reached conditions and remaining formative organization.

**Significance:** It turns ‘generative relations are indispensable’ from a slogan into a chain of checkable necessity conditions and counterexamples, and shows how to correct the dual presupposition of mistaking a representational boundary for a foundational one.

**Scope:** Each round compiles under Lean 4.29.1 with dependency reports separated into empty, standard and classical-choice; they must not be summarized as zero-axiom. Finite formal success does not replace the universal inference. This is not a proof of universal uniqueness without substantive premises.

**Next:** Explain why adequate explanations in arbitrary different syntaxes can warrantedly recover the links that must be kept; this is the next universal inference.

<a id="g0-warrant"></a>
<a id="g0-的根据一项采用的公理怎样得到支持--the-warrant-for-g0-how-an-adopted-axiom-is-supported"></a>
## The warrant for G0: how an adopted axiom is supported

**ID:** `g0-warrant` · **Category:** normative foundation

**Source:** [G0-WARRANT.md](../chapters/G0-WARRANT.md)

**Status:** Comparative support for an adopted axiom; universal practical warrant open

**Reading status:** the source changed after this reading (read version sha256 `49bf5e0350e2…`). The entry describes that earlier version; it awaits a reread before its hash is refreshed.

**Argument:** G0 (living and further generation within the whole have basic positive normative significance) is the axiom Ren explicitly adopted. A link between a normative predicate and descriptive relations either does not exist or is itself a commitment, so having an axiom is no defect relative to rivals. G0 supplies valence only; D/P, J1–J4 and E carry reasons, comparisons and correspondence. Four kinds of support: explanatory unification (care, repair, creation, rest, finite fulfillment and ending from one ground); discrimination (under a supplied no-recovery wear law, `Ceaseless` and `KeepsCapacity` separate formation within renewal from formation exceeding it without any goodness predicate, which neither event-wise G0 nor C does; externalizing consumption must be read over every dependent relation’s continuation); discrimination against rivals (in a constructed case G0 leaves ordering open, J2 does not follow from C, every natural-number score trades, and a bounded score represents J2); and fruitfulness for alignment. Content characterization: on a connected whole G0 is equivalent to seed ∧ N_rel ∧ N_std, and each normative rival is the same rule within a formed boundary. The evaluator route reaches a standpoint-indexed single-history instance of G0 from S0.

**Significance:** It turns ‘G0 is an axiom’ from a weakness into a comparable public commitment, stating what it explains, how much it assumes, which positions it addresses and what would revise it, while limiting Lean’s role to inference, premise footprint, descriptive distinctions and independence.

**Scope:** The chapter neither proves G0 nor converts it into a theorem. The dynamical theorems are sign-neutral by construction; that the formal readings capture 生生 is a correspondence question, and ‘consuming is worse’ is carried by C. The protection-versus-gains case does not separate J2 from bounded-sensitivity rivals. Revision conditions are listed in §4.

**Next:** The universal practical warrant remains open: D splits into the externalist articulation A and standpoint neutrality N_std, neither yet argued from an agent’s own standpoint; the law class needs recovery, rest and externalized consumption.

<a id="generated-logic"></a>
<a id="生成条件与逻辑规则--conditions-of-becoming-and-logical-rules"></a>
## Conditions of becoming and logical rules

**ID:** `generated-logic` · **Category:** mathematics

**Source:** [GENERATED-LOGIC.md](../chapters/GENERATED-LOGIC.md)

**Status:** Four checked rounds; constitutive assessment complete, presuppositionless metalogic unproved

**Reading status:** the source changed after this reading (read version sha256 `05d146dc5ab2…`). The entry describes that earlier version; it awaits a reread before its hash is refreshed.

**Argument:** Logical rules are studied as relations of resources, activities and judgments within one unfolding. In a resource derivation calculus with no contraction constructor, contraction is admissible in the declared contexts exactly when duplication is reachable; finite provision supports only paid replacement, and serial reuse does not ensure overlapping occupancy. The second round derives exact frozen-context conditions from shared histories: a total-count summary loses readiness, while a workload-restricted one-bit summary keeps selected event words but loses full initial compatibility. The third round shows that the scope of permitted future rewiring fixes which occupancy distinctions a summary must keep; the fourth projects record-supported execution onto the same native occupancy process under explicit reading, versioning and atomic-use conditions. Finally the immanent grounding of metalogic is tested: a fresh reference can be instituted by its introduction, and retention and substitution under unchanged content and assessment explain local transmission of warrant without a fresh endorsement premise at each step; every consumer evaluates equally before and after substitution exactly when each replacement supplies the ground of its position.

**Significance:** It gives exact criteria for when generative conditions support a logical rule, and replaces the blanket demand for an external certificate on every binding with a testable local constitutive account.

**Scope:** Lean remains the explicit metatheory; the object calculus covers configurations only, not a full propositional language. Round one 38 theorems; round two 37 / 220 closure audits; round three 24; round four 28; substitution 9 theorems recorded separately. Neither all classical logic, a universal process law nor logical novelty is established; physical sensing and synchronization are realization obligations. The constitutive assessment adds no theorem.

**Next:** Local institution and retention of reference do not yet show that all metainferential resources used to summarize and assess it are justified without presupposition. This is an internal explanation not yet closed, not an independent fact/value or knower/world ontology.

<a id="goal-formation-and-revision"></a>
<a id="理解并改变自身形成条件--understanding-and-changing-ones-formative-conditions"></a>
## Understanding and changing one's formative conditions

**ID:** `goal-formation-and-revision` · **Category:** learning

**Source:** [GOAL-FORMATION-AND-REVISION.md](../history/GOAL-FORMATION-AND-REVISION.md) · earlier chapter, kept in history at its original scope

**Status:** Checked conditional results and scoped empirical correspondence

**Argument:** Formed intelligence can acquire a calibrated, defeasible account of how its aims arose, compare those aims with their actual consequences, form different aims, and change the selection rules that keep shaping it, with authority and at a cost; later action depends on the revised aims and changes subsequent learning. Reflection is a capacity acquired within the same process, not an exit from it. Reward explains why an aim was retained, not why it deserves continuation. Revising an aim differs from improving means to the old aim: in a constructed learning case the old attendance aim still receives high feedback, while the revised mastery aim reorders practices under G0 and J2. Later sections show that reform can change its own evidential conditions, add RS (equal basic risk sharing), prove reliable estimation, tracking and conditional convergence in situational awareness, connect diagnosis to a revised predictor, and test convergence and context-sensitive updating against public data (16 participants, 2,656 measurements; 24 participants, 2,304 triplets).

**Significance:** It shows how an aligned system can understand and justifiably change its formative conditions, while distinguishing memory change, expression and deliberate correction, so that ‘continued convergence’ must say which quantity converges, along which relation and within what range.

**Scope:** The full controller still has a supplied higher-level response rule; the finite realization does not show that every intelligence develops this capacity or universal semantic sufficiency. Reform evidence: 23 theorems / 43 audits. The data work is secondary analysis of real observations, not a new experiment: the perturbation contrast increases by 0.10666 [0.05795, 0.15781], while the cue-contrast increase is uncertain. No universal convergence claim.

**Next:** The next empirical comparison separates memory change, retrieval, expression and deliberate correction; explicit recognition of one’s formative conditions and justified revision of final goals keep their own evidence and normative grounds.

<a id="knowledge"></a>
<a id="生成中的知识--knowledge-within-becoming"></a>
## Knowledge within becoming

**ID:** `knowledge` · **Category:** philosophical epistemic

**Source:** [KNOWLEDGE.md](../chapters/KNOWLEDGE.md)

**Status:** Defended candidate complete; universal validation open

**Reading status:** the source changed after this reading (read version sha256 `117c4d91023f…`). The entry describes that earlier version; it awaits a reread before its hash is refreshed.

**Argument:** Propositional knowledge is a true commitment whose formation or present maintenance is competently connected to what makes it correct, whose correctness is not accidental relative to relevant error possibilities, and which is available within the knower’s cognitive activity. Knowing that, understanding and knowing how are different achievements. A knowing position differentiates within one history as an organized capacity to take up some differences: a difference can leave a trace without being accessible, accessible information can be misunderstood, and a judgment can be right about a narrow relation yet wrong about its explanation. The chapter explains how content becomes available and stays fallible, how relevant error possibilities are fixed, how reasons and standards enter, how knowledge survives changed concepts and methods, and objectivity, extrapolation, sufficient understanding and timely response. Completed connections include selective revision and warranted reliance, the evidence-guided model-revision cycle, and the boundary of scientific compatibility: scientific accounts that undertake to explain evidence and correction must retain the relevant actual dependencies, yet compatibility is weaker than acceptance and insufficient for truth.

**Significance:** It supplies the theory’s epistemology: knowledge forms within relations, without treating a representation as proof of what it represents and without positing the whole as one conscious knower.

**Scope:** The definition is a defended candidate, not a settlement of every debate in the analysis of knowledge, and not a consequence of G0 alone. Lean checks only components: exact binary questions over a declared history family; selective revision, 16 theorems / 1,296 model cases; compatibility boundary, 8 theorems / 11 empty audits. Knowledge is not defined as zero-error classification.

**Next:** New living beyond independently warranted claims and preservation targets: identify actual formation, continuity and destruction without encoding a favorable verdict in the target’s definition. Whether conditional care exhausts reasons about formation remains disputed.

**Lean correspondence:** [KnowledgeCorrespondence.lean](../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/inquiry-root/KnowledgeCorrespondence.lean) · [SelectiveRevision.lean](../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/inquiry-root/SelectiveRevision.lean) · [SourceReliance.lean](../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/inquiry-root/SourceReliance.lean) · [ModelRevision.lean](../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/inquiry-root/ModelRevision.lean) · [ScientificCompatibility.lean](../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/inquiry-root/ScientificCompatibility.lean)

## Living dependencies within generative continuation

**ID:** `living-dependencies` · **Category:** mechanism mathematics

**Source:** [LIVING-DEPENDENCIES.md](../history/LIVING-DEPENDENCIES.md) · earlier chapter, kept in history at its original scope

**Status:** General account complete at declared scope; universal eventual insufficiency unproved

**Argument:** Transport changes a relevant amount and active compensation requires work; composing these relations derives a general support account. The maintained-regime result extends to necessary accounting for actual bounded endpoints, allowing bidirectional passive transfer and intermediate excursions. Passive relief, tolerance, retained work and finite provision are counted; an excursion alone does not require fresh input. The completed account joins maintenance, retained or recovered organization and changing joint provision: renewal is necessary only under actual insufficiency and adequate only when it supports the identified later function.

**Significance:** Derives a previously supplied support account from a mechanism, advancing the real-living correspondence of general continuation proofs.

**Scope:** Maintenance ten theorems/twenty audits; recovery fifteen/twenty; organizational origin 22/47; joint allocation 16/32; expanding provision 14/19. Transport, units, bounds and work coupling require real correspondence; a batch partition supplies no physical clock and a protein ratio does not define life. No proof that every possible life must eventually renew, and no universal ethical completion.

**Next:** Continued in SUSTAINED-LIVING-JUDGMENT, which joins the organizational results to explicit protection principles and shared division of labour. Applications can reuse existing rate, composition and succession results; universal eventual insufficiency and cross-stage scale remain open.
